facts.text: I am looking to optimize my hashtag strategy on Instagram.
I have been tracking my hashtag performance using an analytics tool for the past month.
My posts with hashtags get an average of 3x more engagement than those without.
I have a branded hashtag named #SweatWithSamantha.
I want to incorporate my branded hashtag #SweatWithSamantha into my Instagram posts and stories.
I want to create Instagram Reels to promote my branded hashtag #SweatWithSamantha and encourage more user-generated content.
I plan to create a 60-second workout challenge Reel.
I plan to ask my followers to share their own attempts using #SweatWithSamantha.
I plan to use Eminem - Lose Yourself as the background music for my Reel.
I plan to collaborate with Natalie Jill.
Natalie Jill has a huge following in the weightlifting niche.
Natalie Jill's fitness style aligns with my brand values.
I will ask Natalie Jill to share a weightlifting routine using my branded hashtag #SweatWithSamantha.
I will offer to feature Natalie Jill in a Reel or post on my Instagram page.
